Filgotinib is a new treatment preparation for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). In 2024, it received a new treatment code in the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR) [^src1]. This administrative update is significant because it enables the inclusion of filgotinib in the data for Indicator 5 of the DANIBD report, which tracks fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving biological and small molecule (BMSL) treatments.

The introduction of this code was part of a broader methodological update documented in the 2024 DANIBD report. Alongside filgotinib, new treatment codes were established for several other modern biologics and JAK inhibitors, including [[upadacitinib]], [[risankizumab]], [[mirikizumab]], and [[ozanimod]] [^src1]. These updates reflect the ongoing integration of new therapies into national registries, allowing for more precise tracking of treatment quality and surgical outcomes across regions and departments.
